svg.desc: Yao et al. 2009 DOI 10.1021/ja900042y. Tetranitromethane oxidative gelant. 0.05 mL of 3% methanolic solution per 4 mL sol. Oxidative decomplexation is reported; exact gel network chemistry is not atomistically resolved. This is an original identity card, not a measured molecular structure.
